title: LockerPeopleSlot
description: locker.people-slot@1: the content key wrapped for one person. The wrapping key is ECDH P-256 (an ephemeral key pair per envelope) put through HKDF-SHA-256, and the content key is sealed with AES-256-GCM. The tag covers the subject, the ephemeral public key and the salt, so a slot cannot be moved to another person or to another envelope.

salt.description: Sixteen random bytes, base64: the HKDF salt for this slot.

nonce.description: Twelve random bytes, base64: the AES-GCM nonce of the wrapped content key.

wrapped_key.description: The 32-byte content key and its 16-byte tag, base64. Never the key itself.
